sources.title: docs.netlify.com: уся документація платформи
sources.note: Every page of docs.netlify.com/sitemap.xml (build, deploy, functions, edge functions, storage, domains, security, accounts, visual editor, extensions, frameworks, prompt templates), fetched as markdown with `Accept: text/markdown`. Not versioned: a current snapshot. `drop` removes the llms.txt notice at the top of every page. sitemap.xml lists 18 prompt-template pages more than sitemap-0.xml.

sources.title: www.netlify.com/changelog: журнал змін платформи
sources.note: Every dated changelog entry (2023 on); the tag listings /changelog/<tag>/ are left out by `match` — they repeat the entries. The date from the address goes into the title.

sources.title: www.netlify.com/blog: статті блогу
sources.note: Every blog post 2015 on; paginated and category listings are excluded. `drop` cuts everything from 'Written by' (author, share links, related posts). The title loses ' | Netlify'; the date from the address (older posts) goes into the title.

sources.title: www.netlify.com/knowledge-base: статті бази знань
sources.note: Knowledge-base articles of www.netlify.com, as markdown with `Accept: text/markdown`.

sources.title: developers.netlify.com/guides: посібники для розробників
sources.note: Developer guides (functions, edge functions, Blobs, frameworks, SDK, admin). The page has no markdown twin at its address; its 'Markdown' button loads /api/guides/<slug>/raw, and that is where the text is taken from. The raw text has no title, so the title comes from the <h1> of the page itself.
